# [TASK] Frontend: route dictated search through the natural-language query pipeline

## Task

Route VoiceControl's dictated search command through the same natural-language pipeline instead of the current verbatim substring match.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A dictated complex query (e.g. "movies Tom Hanks directed in the 2000s") resolves the same way the typed equivalent does
- [x] A dictated plain-title query ("search Inception") still resolves correctly via the plain-title fallback
- [x] voiceCommands.js's old verbatim /\bsearch(?: for)?\s+(.+)/ substring behavior is removed, not left as a second, inconsistent path
- [x] VoiceControl.test.jsx updated to cover the new routing, not just the old regex behavior

## Notes

- Successfully implemented and tested. `VoiceControl` now dispatches the AI search flow `aiSearchStarted` and `executeSearch`.
